evidence.notes: Card PR CI was green on its first run. Worker's local full npm test: failed twice: 61 then 3 git-spawning tests timed out at 15 s under parallel worker load; not rerun.. That run shared the machine with seven other workers' suites; the integrated branch then passed the full suite on a quiet machine (above). Test-infrastructure fixes made during the bundle: #34 (tests opening workspaces directly no longer force disk syncs) and #36 (installer test starts a 45 KB stand-in instead of a copied node.exe).
